name: Invoice Maker
description: Create clean, professional invoices with items, tax and discount, ready to send or print.
prompt: An invoice maker where I fill in my details, the client, invoice number and dates, items with quantity and price, tax and discount, and see a clean professional invoice I can print as PDF or share.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Crea facturas limpias y profesionales con conceptos, impuestos y descuento, listas para enviar o imprimir.
